policy.primaryNoticeRule: The 2026-07-21 first-phase notice is the verified baseline for registration rules unless a later official notice is reviewed and shown to modify a specific rule.
policy.supplementaryNoticeRule: Later notices are tracked independently. Do not infer an extension, replacement rule, passport exception, payment exception or other operational detail from a title alone.

notices.titleNe: सन् २०२६ को प्रथम चरणको कोरियन भाषा परीक्षाको आवेदन फाराम दर्ता गर्ने सम्बन्धि सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: 2026 first-phase Korean-language examination application registration notice
notices.safeEffect: Baseline exact registration, eligibility, fee, upload and EPS-TOPIK rules are extracted into the Nepal exact-answer catalog.

notices.titleNe: भाषा परीक्षाको आवेदन दिनेहरुका लागि अत्यन्त जरुरी सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: Very urgent notice for language-test applicants
notices.safeEffect: The existence and date of this supplementary notice are verified. Do not change any exact registration rule solely from the title.

notices.titleNe: आवेदन प्रकृया हाललाई स्थगित गरिएको सम्बन्धमा ।
notices.titleEn: Notice that the application process was temporarily suspended
notices.safeEffect: Treat the online application process as having experienced a temporary suspension on 2026-07-28. Do not infer a deadline extension or other rule change.

notices.titleNe: अनलाईन दरखास्त प्रणाली पुन: सुचारु भएको सम्बन्धी सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: Notice that the online application system resumed
notices.safeEffect: Treat the online application system as having resumed after the temporary suspension. No deadline extension is claimed.

notices.titleNe: अनलाईन दरखास्त पेश गर्ने तथा राहदानी सम्बन्धमा ।
notices.titleEn: Notice regarding online application submission and passport
notices.safeEffect: A later official passport/application notice exists. Exact passport or submission guidance from the primary notice must not be presented as exhaustive until this notice's content is reviewed.
